title: Entire life
subtitle: 「一生／整個人生」，究竟是哪一種 entire life？
description: 「一生／整個人生」，究竟是哪一種 entire life？

words.note: 最直接、最自然的近義詞之一，表示一個人的全部人生。
words.example: She has lived in the same town her whole life.
words.exampleZh: 她一生都住在同一個小鎮。

exercises.original: She has lived in the same village her entire life.
exercises.zh: 她一生都住在同一個村莊。
exercises.upgrade: whole life · 一生；整個人生

options.explanation: has lived ... her whole life 是極自然的完成式搭配，表示從出生至今整段人生都如此。
只包括成年後，無法涵蓋童年。
標準詞是 life expectancy，且表示統計預期壽命，不是實際人生經歷。
是形容詞，不能直接說 her lifelong 作時間狀語。
形容詞「活着的」，詞性和語義都不合。

exercises.original: He spent his entire life working with horses.
exercises.zh: 他一生都與馬匹工作。
exercises.upgrade: whole life · 整個人生

options.explanation: spent his whole life doing... 是高頻固定結構，表示整段人生都投入某活動。
需要修飾名詞，如 lifelong career。
living 可表示生活／生計，不等同一生時間跨度。

exercises.original: My grandfather stayed in that town for his entire life.
exercises.zh: 我祖父一輩子都留在那個小鎮。
exercises.upgrade: whole life · 一輩子

options.explanation: for his whole life 清楚表達完整人生跨度。
估計壽命，不是實際經歷。
形容詞，不可單獨作時間名詞。

words.note: 表示在整段人生中一直如此，語氣稍比 whole life 完整、書面。
words.example: He had wanted to be a teacher all of his life.

exercises.original: He had wanted to become a teacher for his entire life.
exercises.zh: 他一生都想成為老師。
exercises.upgrade: all of his life · 一生；終其一生

options.explanation: had wanted + lifelong desire 非常適合 all of his life，表示這個願望貫穿整段人生。
明確排除童年，不等於一生。
結構錯誤，而且 life expectancy 不是個人實際經歷。
需改成 a lifelong ambition 等名詞結構。

exercises.original: She had known the family for her entire life.
exercises.zh: 她一生都認識這個家庭。
exercises.upgrade: all of her life · 終其一生

options.explanation: had known 表示關係從很早開始一直持續，這個片語自然表達整段人生。
life expectancy 是統計預測，不是這種時間狀語。
需要修飾名詞，例如 a lifelong acquaintance。

exercises.original: He had feared deep water for his entire life.
exercises.zh: 他一輩子都害怕深水。
exercises.upgrade: all of his life · 一輩子

options.explanation: 這是持續性狀態 had feared，用 all of his life 十分自然。

words.note: 非常自然、常用，與 all of one's life 幾乎相同，但語氣更簡潔。
words.example: She has loved music all her life.

exercises.original: She has loved books her entire life.
exercises.zh: 她一生都喜愛書籍。
exercises.upgrade: all her life · 一生；一輩子

options.explanation: present perfect + continuing preference，all her life 是最自然的高頻表達之一。
需改成 a lifelong love of books。

exercises.original: He worked hard his entire life.
exercises.zh: 他一生都很努力工作。
exercises.upgrade: all his life · 終其一生

options.explanation: 簡潔自然，適合概括終身行為。
形容詞，不能作獨立時間狀語。

exercises.original: They had lived beside the sea for their entire lives.
exercises.zh: 他們一生都住在海邊。
exercises.upgrade: all their lives · 一生

options.explanation: 複數主語要用 lives；這是非常自然的完整人生時間狀語。

words.note: 形容詞，表示某種興趣、習慣、關係或狀態持續一生。
words.example: He developed a lifelong interest in history.
words.exampleZh: 他對歷史產生了終身興趣。

exercises.original: His interest in astronomy lasted for his entire life.
exercises.zh: 他對天文學的興趣持續一生。
exercises.upgrade: lifelong · 終身的；一生的

options.explanation: interest 是名詞，lifelong interest 是自然固定搭配，表示興趣持續整個人生。
是名詞；a lifetime interest 雖偶可見但不如 lifelong interest 自然。
語義對，但需要句法重構，例如 He was interested in astronomy all his life；不能直接修飾 interest。

exercises.original: She remained a friend for my entire life.
exercises.zh: 她是我一生的朋友。
exercises.upgrade: lifelong · 終身的

options.explanation: lifelong friend 是高頻自然搭配，表示友誼持續一生。
lifetime 不是這裡最自然的前置形容詞。

exercises.original: Her commitment to education continued throughout her entire life.
exercises.zh: 她對教育的投入是一生的。
exercises.upgrade: lifelong · 一生的

options.explanation: commitment + full-life duration 是 lifelong commitment 的典型搭配。

words.note: 較正式、書面，強調某事在整段人生不同時期持續或反覆出現。
words.example: She remained curious throughout her life.
words.exampleZh: 她終其一生都保持好奇心。

exercises.original: She remained curious during her entire life.
exercises.zh: 她終其一生都保持好奇心。
exercises.upgrade: throughout her life · 一生之中；終其一生

options.explanation: remained 表示持續狀態，throughout 很自然地表示各人生階段皆如此。
可改寫成 lifelong curiosity，但不能直接放在此句時間狀語位置。

exercises.original: He experienced periods of poor health across his entire life.
exercises.zh: 他一生不同時期都曾經歷健康欠佳。
exercises.upgrade: throughout his life · 終其一生

options.explanation: periods 暗示不是持續每一天，而是在人生不同階段反覆出現；throughout 特別適合。

exercises.original: People continue learning during their entire lives.
exercises.zh: 人們一生中都會持續學習。
exercises.upgrade: throughout their lives · 一生中

options.explanation: 複數主語 + lifelong process，這個正式自然片語很合適。

words.word: Over the course of one's life
words.meaning: 在人生歷程中；一生之中
words.note: 強調人生是一段逐步發展的過程，常用於變化、累積、經驗和學習。
words.example: People accumulate many experiences over the course of their lives.
words.exampleZh: 人們在人生歷程中累積許多經驗。

exercises.original: A person's priorities may change during their entire life.
exercises.zh: 一個人的優先事項可能在人生歷程中改變。
exercises.upgrade: over the course of their life · 在人生歷程中；一生之中
exercises.answer: over the course of their life

options.text: over the course of their life
options.explanation: may change 是關鍵；此片語特別適合描述隨人生進程逐步變化。
lifelong 更適合修飾持續不變的特質，不直接表達逐步變化。

exercises.original: People often accumulate different skills during their entire lives.
exercises.zh: 人們在人生歷程中會累積不同技能。
exercises.upgrade: over the course of their lives · 一生之中
exercises.answer: over the course of their lives

options.text: over the course of their lives
options.explanation: accumulate 表示逐步累積，最適合用 process-oriented 片語。

exercises.original: Relationships often change across a person's entire life.
exercises.zh: 人際關係往往在人生歷程中改變。
exercises.upgrade: over the course of a person's life · 在整個人生歷程中
exercises.answer: over the course of a person's life

options.text: over the course of a person's life
options.explanation: 變化和發展 across time 是此片語最自然的功能。

words.meaning: 終其一生；整個生命期間
words.note: 正式而完整，明確表示從生命開始到生命結束的整段時間。
words.example: The condition affected him for his entire lifetime.
words.exampleZh: 這個病況影響了他整整一生。

exercises.original: The condition affected him for his entire life.
exercises.zh: 這個病況影響了他整整一生。
exercises.upgrade: for his entire lifetime · 終其一生；整個生命期間

options.explanation: 明確強調完整生命期間，特別適合病況／狀態持續至一生。
是估計值，不是實際持續時間。

exercises.original: He carried the injury's effects with him for his entire life.
exercises.zh: 這次受傷的影響伴隨他整整一生。
exercises.upgrade: for his entire lifetime · 整個一生

options.explanation: effects persisted across all life stages，這個正式表達很精確。
預期壽命不是實際持續經歷。

exercises.original: The promise remained important to her for her entire life.
exercises.zh: 這個承諾終其一生對她都很重要。
exercises.upgrade: for her entire lifetime · 終其一生

options.explanation: remained important 表示長期持續狀態，完整生命跨度符合語義。

words.note: 與 for one's entire lifetime 接近，但稍自然口語一點。
words.example: She carried the memory with her for her whole lifetime.
words.exampleZh: 她一生都帶着這段記憶。

exercises.original: She kept the photograph for her entire life.
exercises.zh: 她一輩子都保留着這張照片。
exercises.upgrade: for her whole lifetime · 整個一生；一輩子

options.explanation: 保持物件跨越整個人生，這個表達直接自然。

exercises.original: He remained loyal to the club for his entire life.
exercises.zh: 他一生都忠於這個球會。
exercises.upgrade: for his whole lifetime · 一生

options.explanation: remained loyal 指持續整個人生的狀態。

exercises.original: The family remained in the region for their entire lives.
exercises.zh: 這個家庭成員整整一生都留在該地區。
exercises.upgrade: for their whole lifetimes · 整整一生

options.explanation: 複數人物用 lifetimes，表示每個人的整個人生。

words.note: 最明確地表示整個生命跨度，語氣直接、較正式或描述性。
words.example: The biography follows him from birth to death.
words.exampleZh: 這本傳記記錄他從出生到死亡的一生。

exercises.original: The biography follows her entire life, beginning with her birth and ending with her death.
exercises.zh: 這本傳記記錄她從出生到死亡的一生。
exercises.upgrade: from birth to death · 從出生到死亡；一生

options.explanation: 題目明確給出兩個端點 birth 和 death，因此這是最精確的完整生命跨度表達。
life expectancy 是預測統計值。

exercises.original: The study traces the artist's entire life chronologically.
exercises.zh: 研究按時間順序追蹤藝術家從出生到死亡的一生。
exercises.upgrade: from birth to death · 一生

options.explanation: chronological full-life study 最自然用明確端點表達。
可有其他重構，但這個結構不是自然替代。

exercises.original: The documentary covers his entire life rather than only the years of his career.
exercises.zh: 紀錄片涵蓋他從出生到死亡的一生，而不只職業生涯。
exercises.upgrade: from birth to death · 從出生到死亡

options.explanation: 與 not only the years of his career 對比，最清楚表達完整生命跨度。

words.note: 慣用語，表示從出生到死亡，較形象、帶文學或修辭色彩。
words.example: The system was designed to support citizens from cradle to grave.
words.exampleZh: 這套制度旨在從出生到死亡支援公民。

exercises.original: The policy aims to provide support throughout a person's entire life, from infancy to old age and death.
exercises.zh: 這項政策旨在從出生到死亡為人提供終身支援。
exercises.upgrade: from cradle to grave · 從搖籃到墳墓；一生

options.explanation: 這是固定慣用語，特別常用於政策、福利和修辭語境，表示完整人生。

exercises.original: The system collects records across a person's entire life.
exercises.zh: 這個系統收集一個人從出生到死亡的一生記錄。
exercises.upgrade: from cradle to grave · 一生

options.explanation: records covering every life stage can be described rhetorically as cradle-to-grave coverage.

exercises.original: The article describes social protection across the entire life cycle.
exercises.zh: 文章描述涵蓋一生的社會保障制度。
exercises.upgrade: from cradle to grave · 從出生到死亡

options.explanation: social protection + all life stages 是這個慣用表達的經典語境。

words.note: 名詞，可表示一個人的整個生命期間。
words.example: He achieved more in one lifetime than most people could imagine.
words.exampleZh: 他在一生中取得的成就超乎大多數人想像。

exercises.original: He saw enormous social change during his entire life.
exercises.zh: 他一生中見證了巨大的社會變化。
exercises.upgrade: lifetime · 一生；終身

options.explanation: during his lifetime 是固定名詞搭配，表示他活着的整段時間。
是統計預測，不是實際經歷。

exercises.original: Few people achieve so much in one entire life.
exercises.zh: 很少有人能在一生中取得如此多成就。
exercises.upgrade: lifetime · 一生

options.explanation: in one lifetime 是非常自然的固定表達，指一個人的完整生命期間。

exercises.original: The award recognizes achievement across an entire life of work.
exercises.zh: 這個獎項表彰一生工作的成就。
exercises.upgrade: lifetime · 終身

options.explanation: a lifetime of achievement 是高頻正式搭配，表示整個人生累積的成就。
這裡 lifetime 正是名詞，不能當作形容詞分析。

words.note: 較中性、分析性，表示某人的生命長度或某事在生命中的整體跨度。
words.example: The study examines changes across the human life span.
words.exampleZh: 研究探討人類一生不同階段的變化。

exercises.original: The study examines how memory changes across the entire life.
exercises.zh: 研究探討記憶在人類一生不同階段如何改變。
exercises.upgrade: life span · 一生的跨度；生命期間

options.explanation: research + changes across stages 指 developmental span，human life span 是分析性、學術性表達。
是預期活多久，不是人生發展跨度。

exercises.original: Physical ability changes across a person's entire life.
exercises.zh: 身體能力在人一生不同階段會改變。
exercises.upgrade: life span · 生命歷程跨度

options.explanation: changes across 指跨越不同生命階段，比 personal idiom all one's life 更分析性。

exercises.original: The textbook discusses language development over the entire human life.
exercises.zh: 教科書討論語言在人類一生中的發展。
exercises.upgrade: life span · 一生跨度

options.explanation: developmental textbook context 很適合 human life span。
語言發展可持續成年期，過窄。

words.meaning: 從童年到老年；一生大部分階段
words.note: 描述性表達，強調人生多個階段的延續；不一定包括出生和死亡兩端。
words.example: The book follows her from childhood to old age.
words.exampleZh: 這本書記錄她從童年到老年的一生歷程。

exercises.original: The novel follows her entire life, beginning when she is a child and ending in old age.
exercises.zh: 小說記錄她從童年到老年的一生歷程。
exercises.upgrade: from childhood to old age · 從童年到老年；一生大部分階段

options.explanation: 題目直接給出 child → old age 兩端，這個敘事表達最自然。
原句沒有說從出生開始，也沒有說寫到死亡，因此太強。

exercises.original: The photographs show the same person across her entire life, from school years to later years.
exercises.zh: 這些照片展示同一個人從童年到老年的生命歷程。
exercises.upgrade: from childhood to old age · 從童年到老年

options.explanation: school years + later years 指跨越多個人生階段，最合適。
照片未必涵蓋出生與死亡。

exercises.original: The memoir describes how her beliefs changed over her entire life.
exercises.zh: 回憶錄描述她的信念如何從童年到晚年改變。
exercises.upgrade: from childhood to old age · 從童年到晚年

options.explanation: memoir + changing beliefs across stages 是很自然的敘事生命歷程表達。

words.word: For as long as one can remember
words.meaning: 從有記憶以來一直；記憶中一直
words.note: 不是嚴格等於整個一生，而是從最早記憶起一直如此。只有在「記憶中的一生」語境才合適。
words.example: He has loved the sea for as long as he can remember.
words.exampleZh: 從有記憶以來，他一直熱愛大海。

exercises.original: He says he has loved the sea his entire life, although of course he cannot remember infancy.
exercises.zh: 他說自己從有記憶以來一直熱愛大海，當然嬰兒期並不記得。
exercises.upgrade: for as long as he can remember · 從有記憶以來一直；記憶中一直
exercises.answer: for as long as he can remember

options.text: for as long as he can remember
options.explanation: 題目特別指出無法記得 infancy，因此這不是字面「從出生起」，而是 memory horizon。
太字面且不符合他仍在世／不能記得嬰兒期。

exercises.original: She has wanted to work with animals her entire life, at least from her earliest memories.
exercises.zh: 至少從最早的記憶開始，她一直都想和動物工作。
exercises.upgrade: for as long as she can remember · 從有記憶以來
exercises.answer: for as long as she can remember

options.text: for as long as she can remember
options.explanation: from her earliest memories 是直接線索；這個片語非常自然。
她仍在世，而且無法證明嬰兒期已有同一願望。
願望可能持續到現在，過窄。

exercises.original: They have known each other for their entire lives, or at least since either of them can remember.
exercises.zh: 至少從兩人有記憶以來，他們一直互相認識。
exercises.upgrade: for as long as they can remember · 記憶中一直
exercises.answer: for as long as they can remember

options.text: for as long as they can remember
options.explanation: 題目自己限定為 since either ... can remember，所以這個 memory-based idiom 最精確。
過度字面，而且兩人仍在世。

falseSynonyms.zh: whole life 更自然口語；entire life 稍強調「全部、完整」。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She has lived here her whole life. She devoted her entire life to the project.

falseSynonyms.zh: lifetime 常用於 in a lifetime、during his lifetime 等結構。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON He lived there his entire life. He saw many changes during his lifetime.

falseSynonyms.zh: lifelong 必須修飾名詞，如 lifelong friend、lifelong passion。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She loved music her entire life. She had a lifelong love of music.

falseSynonyms.zh: 時間跨度完全不同，不能因為都有「整段時間」就混用。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON He worked all day. He worked in the same profession his whole life.

falseSynonyms.zh: childhood 不能代替 entire life。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She lived abroad during childhood. She lived abroad throughout her life.

falseSynonyms.zh: 它從成年開始，並不包含童年。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON He spent most of adulthood in London. He spent his whole life in Britain.

falseSynonyms.zh: 它不是某個人實際的一生。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Life expectancy has increased in many countries. He lived in the same village his entire life.

falseSynonyms.zh: alive 是形容詞「活着的」，不是「一生」這個時間名詞短語。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She was still alive at ninety. She had lived in the house all her life.
